newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Russia's Tyumen Oil Co, Ukraine, to set up group.
newsitem.headline: Russia's Tyumen Oil Co, Ukraine, to set up group.

text.p: Russia's Tyumen Oil Company and Ukraine's Southern Fuel and Energy Complex signed a protocol on Friday to create a financial-industrial group to produce and export oil, a regional Ukrainian official said.
Ruslan Bodelan, head of the Odessa regional administration, said the group would recover crude oil in Russia and transport it to Ukraine and beyond via existing pipelines and the port of Odesssa.
Some of the oil, to be produced in Russia's Tyumen region, where the Tyumen Oil Company is based, would be refined at facilities in Ryazan, Russia, and in Kherson and Odessa, both in Ukraine.
The protocol was signed by Tyumen president Yuri Shafranik, who is Russia's former fuel and energy minister, and by Valery Yudik of the Southern Fuel and Energy Complex.
The latter groups Odessa's port, railway and oil refinery, the Eximneftoprodukt trading company, the Sintez-Oil firm and the Morskoi Trade Bank.
The Tyumen Oil Company's main production unit is Nizhnevartovskneftegaz. -- Evhen Volokin, Kiev Bureau +380 44 229 2264
